title: "Healthy-lifestyle metabolomic signature"
format: html
execute:
  eval: false
  echo: true
---

## Setup

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(broom)
  library(glmnet)
})

score_path <- "data/healthy_lifestyle_scores.tsv"
metabolome_path <- "data/metabolome.tsv"
white_id_path <- "data/white_british_ids.txt"
result_dir <- "results/07_signature"
dir.create(result_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

seed <- 20240201
nfolds <- 10
alpha <- 0.5
significance_cutoff <- 0.05 / 313

quote_name <- function(x) {
  paste0("`", gsub("`", "", x, fixed = TRUE), "`")
}

component_names <- c(
  "smoking_behavior_score",
  "alcohol_consumption_score",
  "physical_activity_score",
  "sleep_duration_score",
  "sedentary_behavior_score",
  "social_contact_score",
  "diet_score"
)
```

## Multivariable metabolite screening

```{r}
score_df <- readr::read_tsv(score_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(eid))
white_ids <- readr::read_lines(white_id_path)
metabolome_df <- readr::read_tsv(metabolome_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(eid = as.character(IID))

analysis_df <- metabolome_df |>
  inner_join(score_df, by = "eid") |>
  filter(eid %in% white_ids)

metabolites <- setdiff(names(metabolome_df), c("FID", "IID", "eid"))

screening_df <- analysis_df |>
  select(eid, healthy_lifestyle_score, all_of(metabolites)) |>
  drop_na()

screening_fit <- lm(
  reformulate(quote_name(metabolites), response = "healthy_lifestyle_score"),
  data = screening_df
)

screening_results <- broom::tidy(
  screening_fit,
  conf.int = TRUE
) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") |>
  transmute(
    metabolite = stringr::str_remove_all(term, "`"),
    estimate,
    std.error,
    statistic,
    p.value,
    conf.low,
    conf.high,
    n = nobs(screening_fit),
    significant = p.value < significance_cutoff
  ) |>
  arrange(p.value)

selected_metabolites <- screening_results |>
  filter(significant) |>
  pull(metabolite)

readr::write_csv(
  screening_results,
  file.path(result_dir, "association_results.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  screening_results |> filter(significant),
  file.path(result_dir, "significant_metabolites.csv")
)
```

## Individual associations for selected metabolites

```{r}
selected_metabolite_associations <- map_dfr(
  selected_metabolites,
  function(metabolite) {
    model_df <- analysis_df |>
      select(healthy_lifestyle_score, all_of(metabolite)) |>
      drop_na()

    model_fit <- lm(
      reformulate(
        "healthy_lifestyle_score",
        response = quote_name(metabolite)
      ),
      data = model_df
    )

    broom::tidy(model_fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
      filter(term == "healthy_lifestyle_score") |>
      transmute(
        metabolite = metabolite,
        estimate,
        std.error,
        statistic,
        p.value,
        conf.low,
        conf.high,
        n = nobs(model_fit)
      )
  }
)

readr::write_csv(
  selected_metabolite_associations,
  file.path(result_dir, "selected_metabolite_individual_associations.csv")
)
```

## Outer-fold predictions with inner cross-validation

```{r}
signature_df <- analysis_df |>
  select(eid, healthy_lifestyle_score, all_of(selected_metabolites)) |>
  drop_na()

x <- as.matrix(signature_df[, selected_metabolites, drop = FALSE])
y <- signature_df$healthy_lifestyle_score

set.seed(seed)
fold_id <- sample(rep(seq_len(nfolds), length.out = nrow(x)))
out_of_fold_prediction <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(x))

for (fold in seq_len(nfolds)) {
  training <- fold_id != fold
  testing <- fold_id == fold

  fold_fit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
    x = x[training, , drop = FALSE],
    y = y[training],
    family = "gaussian",
    alpha = alpha,
    nfolds = nfolds,
    standardize = TRUE
  )

  out_of_fold_prediction[testing] <- as.numeric(
    predict(
      fold_fit,
      newx = x[testing, , drop = FALSE],
      s = "lambda.min"
    )
  )
}

signature_predictions <- tibble(
  IID = signature_df$eid,
  healthy_lifestyle_score = y,
  meta_signal = out_of_fold_prediction,
  fold = fold_id
)

readr::write_tsv(
  signature_predictions,
  file.path(result_dir, "signature_predictions.tsv")
)
```

## Final signature coefficients

```{r}
final_fit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
  x = x,
  y = y,
  family = "gaussian",
  alpha = alpha,
  nfolds = nfolds,
  standardize = TRUE
)

coefficient_matrix <- as.matrix(coef(final_fit, s = "lambda.min"))
signature_coefficients <- tibble(
  term = rownames(coefficient_matrix),
  coefficient = as.numeric(coefficient_matrix[, 1])
) |>
  filter(coefficient != 0)

readr::write_csv(
  signature_coefficients,
  file.path(result_dir, "signature_coefficients.csv")
)
```

## Lifestyle-component associations of selected metabolites

```{r}
component_associations <- tidyr::crossing(
  metabolite = selected_metabolites,
  component = component_names
) |>
  mutate(
    result = map2(metabolite, component, function(metabolite, component) {
      model_df <- analysis_df |>
        select(all_of(c(metabolite, component))) |>
        drop_na()
      model_fit <- lm(
        reformulate(component, response = quote_name(metabolite)),
        data = model_df
      )
      broom::tidy(model_fit, conf.int = TRUE) |>
        filter(term == component) |>
        select(estimate, std.error, statistic, p.value, conf.low, conf.high) |>
        mutate(n = nobs(model_fit))
    })
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest(result)

readr::write_csv(
  component_associations,
  file.path(result_dir, "metabolite_component_associations.csv")
)
```
